EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION NOTICE
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: RPDS/LND/09/ACQ/05 (RAD). Land Ministry Reference’s No.: 4-3/6/2013/HW/150.
I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of the Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be Acquired:

Following allotment of land depicted as Lot No. 110 in the Plan No.620269 in the cadaster map made by Survey General Situated in Ratnapura Town ( Division No. 12 within Ratnapura Municipal Council area) Village of 152 F, Ratnapura Town West Grama Niladhari Division of Divisional Secretary’s Division Ratnapura in the District of Ratnapura in Sabaragamuwa Province.

Lot No. 110 Name of the Land: Badalowitawaththa; Land Use: Estate ; Claimant: Government; First claimant: Not Found ( Partake by Malalaranasinghage Chamen Gunarathna of 232, Colombo Road, Ratnapura);Extent: 0.0002 Hectare.

Following 03 allotment of land depicted as Lot Nos. 190, 191 and 194 in the plan No. 62030 in the cadaster map made by Surveyour General situated in Ratnapura Village of 152 B. Veralupa Grama Niladhari Division ( Division No. 03 within Ratnapura Municipal Council area) of Divisional Secretary’s Division Ratnapura in the District of Ratnapura in Sabaragamuwa Province.

Lot No. 190 Name of the Land: Paragahakotuwewaththa; Land Use: Road ( Road Development Authority);Claimant: Government; First claimant:Saliya Nalin Rathnayaka, No.240, Colombo Road, Moragahayata, Ratnapura; Extent: 0.0025 Hectare.

Lot No. 191 Name of the Land: Paragahakotuwewaththa; Land Use: Road ( Road Development Authority);Claimant: Government; First claimant: Sonali Apsara Rathnayaka, Colombo Road, Moragahayata, Ratnapura; Extent: 0.0020 Hectare.

Lot No. 194 Name of the Land: Paragahakotuwewaththa; Land Use: Road ( Road Development Authority);Claimant: Government; First claimant:Lanka Orix Leasing Pvt. Ltd, Colombo Road, Moragahayata, Ratnapura; Extent: 0.0005 Hectare

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me at 10.00 a.m. on 26th day of April 2018 at Ratnapura Divisional Secretariat.
